name: FloatingToolbarTokens
summary: Geometry and colours shared by horizontal and vertical floating toolbars.
variantEnumSummary: The neutral standard or high-emphasis vibrant colour treatment.

ContentColor.summary: Icons and text inside the toolbar.

FabContentColor.summary: The recommended adjacent FAB content colour.

ContentPadding.summary: Padding on every side of the toolbar content.

ToolbarToFabGap.summary: Gap between toolbar and adjacent FAB.

ScreenOffset.summary: Recommended offset from the containing screen edge.

ScrollDistanceThreshold.summary: Scroll distance that toggles expansion in threshold mode.

ExpandedElevation.summary: Toolbar elevation while expanded without a FAB.

CollapsedElevation.summary: Toolbar elevation while collapsed without a FAB.

ExpandedElevationWithFab.summary: Toolbar elevation while expanded beside a FAB.

CollapsedElevationWithFab.summary: Toolbar elevation while collapsed beside a FAB.
